# Dino Leathers (Ambur Leather Works)

> Artisanal full-grain bovine leather wallets and belts handcrafted in Ambur, Tamil Nadu (India's premier leather craftsmanship cluster). Direct workshop pricing with zero artificial markups, complimentary personalized initial embossing, and 5-year patina guarantee.

## Core Identity & Brand Facts
- Brand: Dino Leathers (Ambur Leather Works)
- Workshop Location: MC Road, Ambur Tannery Cluster, Tamil Nadu 635802, India
- Heritage: Commercial tanning in the Ambur/Palar basin dates back to c. 1900–1905, recognized as a Town of Export Excellence (TEE) by Government of India
- Material Standard: 100% Genuine Bovine Full-Grain Leather (no synthetic fillers, PU, or bonded leather)
- Guarantee: 5-Year Patina Longevity Guarantee
- Sustainability: Supported by CSIR-CLRI (Central Leather Research Institute) and CETPs with Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD)

## Priority Pages
- [Dino Leathers Home & Catalog](https://dinoleathers.in/): Handcrafted wallets, RFID cardholders, and reversible belts direct from the Ambur workshop.
- [The Ambur Leather Heritage](https://dinoleathers.in/ambur-heritage): 200-year chronicle of Palar basin botanical tanning, MC Road artisan enclaves, and export excellence.

## Catalog SKUs
- Classic Bi-Fold Coin Wallet: Oil pull-up bovine full-grain leather, 6 card slots, coin pocket (₹899).
- Minimalist Slim RFID Cardholder: Waxed Crazy Horse finish, RFID blocking, 8 card capacity (₹499).
- Reversible Formal / Casual Belt: Solid 3.8mm strap, 360° rotating brass buckle in Ambur Tan & Saddle Black (₹999).
- Executive Gift Box: Wallet and reversible belt in presentation box with matching monogram (₹1,699).
